content.text: (b) Install the injectors together with the delivery pipe to the manifold.

content.description: Close-up view of injector installation showing rotation check of injectors in their mounting positions

content.text: (c) Make sure that the injectors rotate smoothly.
If the injectors do not rotate smoothly, the probable cause may be incorrect installation of O-rings. Replace the O-rings.
(d) Install four bolts, torque the bolts.

content.description: Installation of fuel pipe showing proper handling to avoid bending

content.text: (a) Finger tighten the pulsation damper and union bolt with new gaskets on the fuel pipe.
(b) Tighten then being careful not to bend the fuel pipe.

content.description: Installation view of air intake chamber and fuel system components showing wiring connections

content.text: (a) With the ignition switch ON, use a service wire to short both terminals of the fuel pump check connector.
(c) Remove the service wire from the fuel pump check connector.
